arrangement.notes: Sparse verses with strong, aggressive hooks using sample-based arrangement layered with texture bed and impactful one-shot hits. Minimal variation to keep the raw trip hop aesthetic.

event_markers.label: Strong Hook Entrance
event_markers.reason: Increase energy with impactful drum hits using one-shot samples.

event_markers.label: Bridge Texture Layer
event_markers.reason: Add ambient texture bed to emphasize bridge section.

event_markers.label: Verse Sparse Vocals
event_markers.reason: Keep verses sparse with minimal vocal activity.

sample_texture_bed.description: Sample-based ambient textures running through sections to add depth.

one_shot_hits.description: One-shot drum and percussive hits for hooks.

sound_intent.texture_bed: Create continuous ambient layers using chopped samples with subtle evolving textures.
sound_intent.one_shot_hits: Use clean, punchy one-shot samples to highlight hooks distinctly.
sound_intent.minimal_variation: Keep arrangement tight and restrained with slight changes only.

routing_intent.drums: Route all one-shot hits and percussion through a dedicated bus with transient shaping and subtle saturation.
routing_intent.texture_bed: Route texture layers through a reverb send to embed depth without cluttering the mix.

track_roles.drums: Percussive backbone using sample-chopping techniques (e.g. hit, break, stab).
track_roles.chords: Ambient chopped samples providing harmonic pads.
track_roles.melody: Minimal hooks created with selected one-shot melodic samples.
track_roles.vocal: Sparse aggressive vocal chops aligned with hook energy spikes.
track_roles.fx: Texture beds created via sample layering and subtle processing effects.

designer_intent.minimal_variation: Maintain simplicity by limiting changes and focusing on punchy hook moments.
designer_intent.aggressive_mood: Use sharp, assertive samples and limited harmonic content to emphasize aggression.

presetor_intent.preset_selection: Choose presets with raw, gritty sample textures and clean hit response for hooks.

sensei_drum.brief: Create drum parts with sample chopping and one-shot techniques emphasizing aggressive hook hits and minimal verse activity.

bass_generator.brief: Generate sparse bass layers using sample-based sources to support the minimal and aggressive texture.

harmony_generator.brief: Design ambient chord textures mostly through layered sample chopping to provide a subtle harmonic bed.

melody_generator.brief: Create limited melodic hooks using one-shot sampled hits focusing on strong rhythmic phrasing.

ai_designer.brief: Integrate all sample layers into a cohesive arrangement emphasizing sparse verses and strong, energetic hooks.

presetor.brief: Select sound presets appropriate for trip hop style with aggressive and minimal characteristics, prioritizing sample texture clarity.

songgps.brief: Manage section transitions ensuring energy profile matches sparse verses and strong hook dynamics.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Prepare clean, unprocessed channel audio for mixing emphasizing clarity of sample-based arrangement.
